title: Cache poisoning of shared fallback shells via request-supplied placeholder route params
notes: Requires cacheComponents with partialPrefetching unset/false and self-hosted next start.
Route shape: prerenderable param requested with a non-build value, two never-prerenderable params below, layout reads shallower inside Suspense, blocking fallback shell.
Attack supplies percent-encoded bracketed deepest param name (e.g. %5Bthree%5D); shared shell can store persistent 404 across restarts.
fixtureVulnerablePin is filled after empirical reproduction (exact version in affectedRange).
